title: Fish prices up in parts of Northern Mindanao

blocks.text: CAGAYAN DE ORO CITY — Market-goers across Northern Mindanao are feeling the pinch of the rising cost of living at wet markets, as retail fish prices soar in late October amid mounting supply and production bottlenecks. Data from the Bureau of Fisheries and Aquatic Resources in Northern Mindanao (BFAR-10) showed prices of some fish significantly climbing between early and late October. In Camiguin’s Mambajao Public Market, large bangus (milkfish) fetched P230 per kilogram (kg) on Oct. 30 from P200 per kg on Oct. 9.
